title: Falcon / RefinedWeb models
before: The best open weights carried non-commercial licences.
problem: Businesses could not build on LLaMA, and the alternatives were weaker.
breakthrough: A competitive 40B model trained on filtered web data, relicensed to Apache 2.0 within a week of release.
why: It briefly led the open leaderboards and proved permissive licensing at scale was possible before Llama 2 followed.
next: Llama 2's commercial licence, then Mistral's Apache releases.
inherits: Permissive licensing as a competitive lever.
